scope: Q7 cross-domain context only; fixed named families, not recruited questions or reader wins
selection: Coordinator specified GDAL warp vertical-shift single-band/multi-band and Sphinx inheritance-diagram families before this inspection.

families.primary_document_sufficient_for: Explaining when automatic vertical raster-value shifting applies, including the single-band requirement and -novshift override.
families.boundary_condition: Actually use a grid with specified location and absence semantics; distinguish a completed process from a completed height correction.
families.adjacent_documentation_needed_for: Exact PROJ resource lookup and @ optional-grid behavior. The primary GDAL page already flags the dependency, so this is narrow completion of the operational contract, not proof that neighboring documentation is universally indispensable.

documented_or_source_expected.assertion: one-band 100 with constant +20 fixture grid becomes 120
optional missing forward/inverse grid leaves 100 unchanged
automatic two-band case does not apply the height shift

limitations: Synthetic uniform grid does not validate real geoid correctness, grid coverage, datum selection or scientific accuracy.
Two-band, -novshift and mandatory-missing cases are study-authored variants, not claimed upstream tests.
No dependency install, paid service, credentials, remote grid acquisition or full upstream test suite.

optional_upstream_command_not_run.cwd_requirement: An already prepared GDAL source tree at the specified pin with test dependencies

families.domain: Document generation with a native external executable
families.adjacent_document_pin: Official Graphviz CLI website revision 51d048c433e5a80ab51915876b695c971544fe54 (not a Graphviz binary pin)
families.primary_document_sufficient_for: Specifying class inheritance traversal and the caption option on an inheritance-diagram directive.
families.boundary_condition: Produce the PNG/SVG image and corresponding HTML; a loadable Python extension alone does not establish native renderer availability.

documented_or_source_expected.assertion: PNG img markup and Test Foo! caption, with links resolving
SVG object markup and generated SVG links resolving with graphviz_output_format=svg
tests skip when configured native dot cannot be started

actual_runtime.blocker: Sphinx, docutils and pytest are absent in the inspected Python environments.

limitations: dot -V uses check=False in the upstream gate and does not itself prove format support.
The local SVG uses a manually supplied graph from the fixture class chain, not Sphinx-generated DOT; captions, HTML, inventory and hyperlinks remain unexecuted.
The Graphviz documentation revision is later than the pinned Sphinx version; no complete cross-version equivalence is asserted.

optional_upstream_command_not_run.cwd_requirement: An already prepared Sphinx source tree at the specified pin with test dependencies and a usable dot executable

prior_use_disclosures.basis: Coordinator disclosure; no AF-RES-096 source reinspection was needed.

independence_limit: Docs, source and tests share project and author lineage; these are traceable official examples, not independent replications or an estimate of effect size. The common Sphinx test gate was also used in AF-RES-096 and is not counted as new material or a new example.
